IONSettlementReconciliation.title: IONSettlementReconciliation
IONSettlementReconciliation.description: The order's settlement, carried as one object from init to reconciliation. The BAP declares it in init (its payout account, payment method, status PENDING, and estimated figures); the BPP answers in on_init (its payout account, and the figures on its final price, with commission equal to the contract consideration's commission.amount); the BAP records the payment in confirm (status PAID, paidAt, gatewayRef, orderAmount = amount paid); the BPP keeps the figures current in on_cancel and on_update; and each participant sends its figures in /reconcile and /on_reconcile. Before reconciliation the figures are estimates. The buyer's payment is held at the PJP; the figures split it. Invariant: orderAmount.value = netPayable.value + commission.value + withholdingAmount.value + refundAmount.value. On agreement SEAM instructs the PJP to pay netPayable to the BPP and commission to the BAP, return refundAmount to the buyer, and keep withholdingAmount. The payment fields reuse the IONPayment definitions. The payout falls due as the commitments' offers state in policies.settlement (IONTradeOffer); with several offers, the one giving the latest due date applies. Earlier versions carried settlementBasis, settlementWindow and finderFee here; orders that still carry them remain valid (additionalProperties is true), but new settlements omit them.

settlementAccounts.description: Payout accounts, one per receiving participant: the BAP declares its account in init, the BPP adds its own in on_init. The BPP account is required once the payment is no longer PENDING; the BAP account is required when commission is greater than zero.

orderAmount.description: Gross amount the buyer pays for the contract, held at the PJP: the order total in init and on_init, the amount paid from confirm on.

commission.description: Commission the BPP pays the BAP for the contract, equal to commission.amount on the contract's price consideration in force (IONTradeConsideration), which sums the offers' policies.commission entries; the PJP pays it to the BAP. Zero when the offers carry no commission.

withholdingAmount.description: Amount the PJP keeps back, for example against returns.

refundAmount.description: Total the PJP returns to the buyer for the contract.

netPayable.description: Amount the PJP pays to the BPP for this contract: orderAmount − commission − withholdingAmount − refundAmount.

accord.description: Set only in /on_reconcile. true — the counterparty agrees with the figures it received; false — it disagrees (see diffValue and dispute). The batch is agreed, and SEAM triggers the payout, only when every contract in it has accord true.

dueDate.description: Date by which the payout is due: settlementWindow after the settlementBasis event of the commitments' offers' policies.settlement, the latest such date when the offers differ. Required when accord is true.

ReconAmount.title: ReconAmount
ReconAmount.description: One settlement component. In /on_reconcile, diffValue is the counterparty's value minus the value in the /reconcile being answered; it is present only when the two differ.

value.description: Component amount in the settlement currency.

diffValue.description: Counterparty's value minus the value it is answering, when they differ.

Dispute.title: Dispute
Dispute.description: Why the counterparty disagrees with a contract's figures. Required when accord is false.

code.description: Short machine-readable reason, for example COMMISSION_MISMATCH. SETTLEMENT_WINDOW_NOT_REACHED marks a contract sent before its settlement window, which is sent again once due.

SettlementBasis.title: SettlementBasis
SettlementBasis.description: Contract lifecycle event from which a settlement falls due. Used by IONTradeOffer.policies.settlement.settlementBasis. ON_CONFIRMATION starts at order confirmation, AFTER_SHIPMENT at hand-over to logistics, AFTER_DELIVERY at confirmed delivery, and AFTER_RETURN_WINDOW when the applicable return window closes.

SettlementWindow.title: SettlementWindow
SettlementWindow.description: ISO 8601 duration, measured from the SettlementBasis event, within which the settlement must be paid out. Used by IONTradeOffer.policies.settlement.settlementWindow.
